ILX
Description
These commands are used to communicate with iRules Language eXtensions
Command List
ILX::call
- Invokes the specified node method
ILX::init
- Establishes a communication path
from an iRule to the node process.
ILX::notify
- Sends a message to the
specified node method but does not wait for a response
